name: Index Rebalance Evidence Publication Check
outcome: Prove an index rebalance in five independent runs plus a session receipt: record a caller-declared constituent set as of a stated date (ART-557), compute a weight per constituent under a stated methodology from caller-supplied input rows (ART-645), compile one rebalance event into a pack diffing current against prior constituent and weight rows and citing the step 1 and step 2 receipts (ART-646), publish the pack as one sequence-numbered head-commit event for the index stream (ART-658), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run execution hashes (CRY-05). Every constituent row, input row, methodology, and verification claim is caller-supplied and asserted, never fetched; each run is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. This chain attests declared inputs in sequence, it does not verify them against market data, and it is not a live index feed.
